pricing.pricing_notes: 50% non-refundable retainer + signed contract required to book; balance due 30 days before the wedding. Dedicated packages/pricing page exists (https://captureyourevents.com/packages/) but was not fetched this session.

content.description_seo: Capture Your Events is an Orlando, Florida full-service event production company offering photography, videography, DJ services, photo booths, and wedding livestreaming under one roof. Their livestreaming service is built as a turnkey offering — a videographer and equipment are provided, a custom web page is created for remote guests, and video ranges from action-cam setups to high-end cinema cameras depending on budget. The company is licensed and insured and can supply a certificate of insurance to venues that require it, and video delivery (highlight edit plus full upload) typically follows within 90 days of the wedding.
content.one_line_summary: Orlando full-service wedding vendor (photo, video, DJ, photo booth) with a dedicated livestreaming package and a custom guest viewing page.

faq_items.q: Can I rent the equipment and stream it myself?
faq_items.a_summary: No — turnkey service only, includes an operator so clients don't manage the platform or gear.
Yes, fully licensed and insured LLC; can provide a Certificate of Insurance to venues.

faq_items.q: When will we receive our video?
faq_items.a_summary: Live stream has ~10 second delay; edited gallery/video delivered within 90 days of the wedding.

faq_items.q: Do I need internet at my venue?
faq_items.a_summary: Not required — alternative connectivity can be arranged, at a cost tied to required stream quality.
